infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DiabEats uses your camera to scan restaurant menus and packaged-food barcodes, helping you review public label information and diabetes-conscious food patterns.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DiabEats allows you to upload menu photos from your library to analyze food items and provide blood sugar impact insights and meal recommendations.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DiabEats uses your location to show nearby diabetes-friendly restaurants and safe meal options.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: DiabEats can send you daily reminders to check safe meal options before dining out.
